audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 6 read Volibear / Volibear / Skill in both layers while the packet chart gives Skill / Skill / Zaahen. The whys already said 'Levels 4-5 level back to even', 'Level 6 is a coin-flip' and 'Two items in he takes over', so three rows printed a token against their own sentence.
audit.why: His E dash (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) and the Q recast knock-up punish a whiffed walk-up, which is what drags 4-5 back to even. At 6 his R heals him for a portion of the damage it deals on a 110s rank-1 cooldown against your 160s rank-1 Stormbringer, so neither ult wins outright. At two items his Q attack-resets and percent-health E out-rotate a Frenzied Maul loop.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4 and 6 set to the packet sides in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved to 5/10, 5/10 and 3/10, and the three full-layer whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claimed levels 3-6 are 'the strongest your lane will ever be' with a free tower dive, and phases[6].why claimed you are a drain-tank he cannot burst — both stages the packet gives away.
audit.why: Zaahen's R is a damage-and-heal on 110/95/80s, so he does not simply lose the level-6 all-in; and his passive fills with Determination for bonus attack damage and a revive, which is the opposite of a champion who runs out of steam into a durable bruiser. The two-item stage is his.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now pairs Stormbringer with his R's heal and calls 6 a bait-first coin-flip; phases[6].why names the Q resets, empowered E and R heal and redirects Stormbringer to fight-opening.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zaahen's R is described as a 'stat-steal all-in' in whys[4], spikes[2].text and content.mid, and his Q is described as ranged poke ('Q Darkin Glaive poke outside your Q range') in wants.foe[0], spikes[1].text and mid.
audit.why: Riot's text for his R is: he rises, stabs downward, damages enemies and heals for a portion of the damage dealt. There is no stat theft in it — a player told to expect a stat-steal will misjudge both the damage and, more importantly, that fighting him at low health feeds the heal. His Q is not poke either: it empowers his next attack into two slashes with self-healing and can be recast so the following attack knocks up. It is an auto-attack empowerment on 10/9/8/7/6s, so it only reaches you in melee — 'poke outside your Q range' tells you to respect a threat that does not exist and to give up ground for free.
audit.corrected: All three R references now say damage-and-heal; the Q references now describe the double-slash with the knock-up recast rather than ranged poke, and the E is described as the dash-slice it is with its 10s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere on the page.
audit.why: The two numbers that make the advice usable are his E dash at 10s rank 1 (the tool that punishes your whiffed engage) and his R at 110s rank 1 against your Stormbringer's 160s rank 1 — the asymmetry is why baiting his ult first is the whole level-6 plan.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why carries the 10s E, phases[4].why carries the 110s R, and content.mid carries the E cooldown inline.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Zaahen kit file carries no ability names at all (only slot text), and packet.enemyAbilities is null, so the names used on this page — 'Darkin Glaive' for Q and 'Golden Onslaught' for E — cannot be confirmed or refuted from any source in this brief.
audit.why: Asserting or correcting a champion name without a source is exactly what the run forbids. I removed the two unverifiable names only where I was already rewriting the sentence for a separate, verified mechanical error, and replaced them with what Riot's text says the ability does rather than with a guessed name.
audit.corrected: No new ability name was invented. The remaining occurrence in content.late is left untouched and raised as a question.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged "Thundering Smash's" in spikes[0].text. FALSE POSITIVE — Thundering Smash is Volibear's real Q per the kit file; the flag fired on the possessive. Left unchanged.

notes: Two verified mechanical errors fixed. His R was called a 'stat-steal all-in' in three places — Riot's text says he stabs downward and heals for a portion of the damage dealt, which changes the advice completely (fighting him low feeds the heal). His Q was called ranged poke you must respect 'outside your Q range' — it is an attack empowerment that slashes twice, heals him, and can be recast for a knock-up on the following attack, so it only reaches you in melee and the old line gave up ground for free. Also corrected: spikes[2].text credited Stormbringer with a shield; the R grants bonus health, Sky Splitter is the shield. The names 'Darkin Glaive' and 'Golden Onslaught' are unverifiable — the Zaahen kit file carries no ability names and packet.enemyAbilities is null — so I invented nothing and left the remaining occurrence in content.late alone. Chart rows 3, 4 and 6 realigned to the packet in both layers.
